findings.title: decode(encode(d)) drops trailing whitespace in values

contract.claim: For any dict of str to str without '=' or newlines in keys, decode(encode(d)) == d.

evidence.excerpt: decode() is the exact inverse of encode().

findings.traceback: AssertionError: contract fakelib.codec.roundtrip violated: backward(forward(x)) != x
